notes: Thompson's 'Tetracoralla' = Rugosa Milne-Edwards & Haime, 1850. The GBIF backbone has no usage for the order (only homonymous frog/insect genera), so gbif_usage_key is null; WoRMS 380373 ranks it as a class (extinct), ITIS 53854 as an order. NCBI has only an unrelated frog genus 'Rugosa' (1673081), not used.
